3410-the-american-spirit-in-literature-a.title: The American Spirit In Literature A Chronicle Of Great Inter
3410-the-american-spirit-in-literature-a.creator: Bliss Perry
3410-the-american-spirit-in-literature-a.description: A book by Bliss Perry. dicated, can long endure." Yet the gigantic economic and social changes now in progress are serving to show that the United States has its full share of the anxieties which beset all human institutions in this daily altering world.

64109-the-christmas-reindeer.title: Reindeer
64109-the-christmas-reindeer.creator: Thornton W. Burgess
64109-the-christmas-reindeer.description: A book by Thornton W. Burgess. She had been given this name, because only a few days before her birth, a relative named Tuktu had died; and as is the custom, this name had been given to the baby. She was well named, for caribou were to have much to do with her life. On the very day that she was born, Kutok, her father, had killed a caribou when food was greatly needed.

arxiv-2012-07758.title: h Vacuum structure of the ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} symmetric Georgi-Machacek model
arxiv-2012-07758.creator: Duarte Azevedo, Pedro Ferreira, Heather E. Logan, Rui Santos, [5mm] Centro de Física Teórica e Computacional, Faculdade de Ciências,Universidade de Lisboa, Campo Grande, Edifício C8 1749-016 Lisboa, Portugal, [3mm] ISEL - Instituto Superior de Engenharia de Lisboa,Instituto Politécnico de Lisboa 195
arxiv-2012-07758.description: Abstract We discuss the vacuum structure of a version of the Georgi-Machecek model with an exact ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} symmetry acting on the triplet fields. Besides the usual custodial-symmetric model, with ρ = 1 \rho=1 at tree-level, a model with a dark matter candidate is also viable.

arxiv-2108-13368.title: Robust Interactive Semantic Segmentation of Pathology Images with Minimal User Input
arxiv-2108-13368.creator: Mostafa Jahanifar, Neda Zamani Tajeddin, Navid Alemi Koohbanani, Nasir Rajpoot
arxiv-2108-13368.description: Abstract From the simple measurement of tissue attributes in pathology workflow to designing an explainable diagnostic/prognostic AI tool, access to accurate semantic segmentation of tissue regions in histology images is a prerequisite. However, delineating different tissue regions manually is a laborious, time-consuming and costly task that requires expert knowledge.

arxiv-2110-04451.title: Using Multiple Reference Audios and Style Embedding Constraints for Speech Synthesis
arxiv-2110-04451.creator: Cheng Gong, Longbiao Wang, Zhenhua Ling, Ju Zhang, Jianwu Dang
arxiv-2110-04451.description: Abstract The end-to-end speech synthesis model can directly take an utterance as reference audio, and generate speech from the text with prosody and speaker characteristics similar to the reference audio. However, an appropriate acoustic embedding must be manually selected during inference.

arxiv-2203-15942.title: Combinatorics of Triangular Partitions
arxiv-2203-15942.creator: François Bergeron, Mikhail Mazin
arxiv-2203-15942.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by François Bergeron, Mikhail Mazin. The aim of this paper is to develop the combinatorics of constructions associated to what we call triangular partitions . As introduced in [ 9 ] , these are the partitions whose cells are those lying below the line joining points ( r , 0 ) (r,0) and ( 0 , s ) (0,s) , for any given positive reals r r and s s .

arxiv-2205-09097.title: The security strength of Blockchain technology : A Survey Report
arxiv-2205-09097.creator: Md Arquam, Ashish Patel, Parma Nand
arxiv-2205-09097.description: Abstract The advent of blockchain technology by the Nakamoto group in 2008 has created a new trend on how to deal with various security issues and vulnerabilities. Blockchain systems have gained momentum in various spheres of technology deployment in business organizations.

arxiv-2305-12315.title: Reducing the instability of an optical lattice clock using multiple atomic ensembles
arxiv-2305-12315.creator: Xin Zheng 1, Jonathan Dolde 1, Shimon Kolkowitz 1,2
arxiv-2305-12315.description: Abstract The stability of an optical atomic clock is a critical figure of merit for almost all clock applications. To this end, much optical atomic clock research has focused on reducing clock instability by increasing the atom number, lengthening the coherent interrogation times, and introducing entanglement to push beyond the standard quantum limit.

arxiv-2306-06465.title: Simultaneous Trajectory Optimization and Contact Selection for Multi-Modal Manipulation Planning
arxiv-2306-06465.creator: Mengchao Zhang 1 , Devesh K. Jha 2 , Arvind U. Raghunathan 2 , Kris Hauser 1
arxiv-2306-06465.description: Abstract Complex dexterous manipulations require switching between prehensile and non-prehensile grasps, and sliding and pivoting the object against the environment. This paper presents a manipulation planner that is able to reason about diverse changes of contacts to discover such plans.

arxiv-2403-13748.title: Variational Inference for Uncertainty Quantification: an Analysis of Trade-offs
arxiv-2403-13748.creator: Charles C. Margossian cmargossian@flatironinstiute.org, Loucas Pillaud-Vivien loucas.pillaud-vivien@enpc.fr, Lawrence K. Saul lsaul@flatironinstitute.org
arxiv-2403-13748.description: Abstract Given an intractable distribution p p , the problem of variational inference (VI) is to find the best approximation from some more tractable family 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} . Commonly, one chooses 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} to be a family of factorized distributions (i.e., the mean-field assumption), even though p p itself does not factorize.

arxiv-2404-01977.title: Least Squares Inference for Data with Network Dependency
arxiv-2404-01977.creator: Jing Lei, Kehui Chen, Haeun Moon
arxiv-2404-01977.description: Abstract Abstract We address the inference problem concerning regression coefficients in a classical linear regression model using least squares estimates. The analysis is conducted under circumstances where network dependency exists across units in the sample. Neglecting the dependency among observations may lead to biased estimation of the asymptotic variance and often inflates the Type I error in coefficient inference.

arxiv-2405-10725.title: indus : Effective and Efficient Language Models for Scientific Applications
arxiv-2405-10725.creator: Bishwaranjan Bhattacharjee, Aashka Trivedi, Masayasu Muraoka, Muthukumaran Ramasubramanian, Takuma Udagawa, Iksha Gurung, Rong Zhang, Bharath Dandala, Rahul Ramachandran, Manil Maskey, Kaylin Bugbee, Mike Little, Elizabeth Fancher, Lauren Sanders, Sylvain Costes, Sergi Blanco-Cuaresma, Kelly Lockhar
arxiv-2405-10725.description: Abstract † † Contact: bhatta@us.ibm.com,aashka.trivedi@ibm.com, muthukumaranr17@gmail.com,rahul.ramachandran@nasa.gov Large language models ( llm s) trained on general domain corpora showed remarkable results on natural language processing ( nlp ) tasks. However, previous research demonstrated llm s trained using domain-focused corpora perform better on specialized tasks.

arxiv-2409-13504.title: Absence of Altermagnetic Spin Splitting Character in Rutile Oxide RuO 2
arxiv-2409-13504.creator: Jiayu Liu, Jie Zhan, Tongrui Li, Jishan Liu, Shufan Cheng, Yuming Shi, Liwei Deng, Meng Zhang, Chihao Li, Jianyang Ding, Qi Jiang, Mao Ye, Zhengtai Liu, Zhicheng Jiang, Siyu Wang, Qian Li, Yanwu Xie, Yilin Wang, Shan Qiao, Jinsheng Wen, Yan Sun, Dawei Shen
arxiv-2409-13504.description: Abstract Rutile RuO 2 has been posited as a potential d d -wave altermagnetism candidate, with a predicted significant spin splitting up to 1.4 eV. Despite accumulating theoretical predictions and transport measurements, direct spectroscopic observation of spin splitting has remained elusive.

arxiv-2411-19909.title: Gravitational form factors of the deuteron
arxiv-2411-19909.creator: J. Yu. Panteleeva, E. Epelbaum, A. M. Gasparyan, J. Gegelia
arxiv-2411-19909.description: Abstract The gravitational form factors of the deuteron are calculated in the framework of non-relativistic chiral effective field theory. Non-relativistic reduction of the matrix element of the energy-momentum tensor operator for spin-one systems is worked out, and the gravitational form factors of the deuteron are extracted from the three-point function of the energy-momentum tensor using the LSZ reduction formula.

arxiv-2512-02213.title: InstructLR: A Scalable Approach to Create Instruction Dataset for Under-Resourced Languages
arxiv-2512-02213.creator: Mamadou K. KEITA, Sebastien Diarra, Christopher Homan, Seydou Diallo
arxiv-2512-02213.description: Abstract Effective text generation and chat interfaces for low-resource languages (LRLs) remain a challenge for state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) to support. This is mainly due to the difficulty of curating high-quality instruction datasets for LRLs, a limitation prevalent in the languages spoken across the African continent and other regions.

arxiv-2512-15590.title: Cancellation problem via locally nilpotent derivations
arxiv-2512-15590.creator: César F. Venegas R, Helbert. J. Venegas R
arxiv-2512-15590.description: Abstract . The Zariski cancellation problem plays a central role in affine algebraic geometry and noncommutative algebra, with locally nilpotent derivations providing a fundamental invariant-theoretic approach. This article presents a unified survey of cancellation phenomena in commutative algebras, noncommutative algebras, and skew (Ore-type) extensions, emphasizing the role of rigidity and the Makar–Limanov invariant.

arxiv-2601-19409.title: Dynamical and observational properties of weakly Proca-charged black holes Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2601-19409.creator: Abylaikhan Tlemissov e1,addr1, Arman Tursunov e2,addr1,addr2, Jiří Kovář e3,addr1, Zdeněk Stuchlík e4,addr1
arxiv-2601-19409.description: Abstract The simplest approach to include a mass into the electromagnetic vector potential is to modify the Einstein-Maxwell action to the Einstein-Proca form. There are currently no exact analytical solutions for this scenario. However, by using perturbation theory, where both the Proca mass and the black hole charge are small parameters, it is possible to find an exact analytical solution.

europmc-pmc2673046.title: The yeast Pif1 helicase prevents genomic instability caused by G-quadruplex-forming CEB1 sequences in vivo.
europmc-pmc2673046.creator: Ribeyre C, Lopes J, Boulé JB, Piazza A, Guédin A, Zakian VA, Mergny JL, Nicolas A.
europmc-pmc2673046.description: In budding yeast, the Pif1 DNA helicase is involved in the maintenance of both nuclear and mitochondrial genomes, but its role in these processes is still poorly understood. Here, we provide evidence for a new Pif1 function by demonstrating that its absence promotes genetic...

kropotkin-memoirs-revolutionist-1899.description: Kropotkin's autobiography: from Russian prince and geographer to the leading theorist of anarchism.

pmc-10674759.title: Removal of Particulate Matter by a Non-Powered Brush Filter Using Electrostatic Forces
pmc-10674759.creator: Jaeseok Heo, Jooyeon Lee, Minyoung Yoon, Duckshin Park
pmc-10674759.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In urban areas, a major source of harmful particulate matter is generated by vehicles. In particular, bus stops, where people often stay for public transportation, generate high concentrations of particulate matter compared to the general atmosphere. In this study, a non-powered type brush filter that generates electrostatic force without using a separate power source was developed to manage the concentration of particulate matter exposed at bus stops, and the removal performance of particulate matter was evaluated.

pmc-11396021.title: 2004–2017 Geospatial dataset of wild and prescribed fire activity over the conterminous United States
pmc-11396021.creator: James Beidler, George Pouliot, Kristen Foley
pmc-11396021.description: Wildland fire activity is provided in a geospatial database of polygons over the conterminous United States for the 2004 through 2017 time period. The location, timing, and size of the fires are derived from a fusion of wildland fire activity from a consistent set of national ground reports, satellite, and geospatial fire data.

pmc-11417315.title: Data-driven analysis that integrates bioinformatics and machine learning uncovers PANoptosis-related diagnostic genes in early pediatric septic shock
pmc-11417315.creator: Jing Wang, ShiFeng Chen, Lei Chen, Dajie Zhou
pmc-11417315.description: ObjectivesSepsis is one of the leading causes of death for children worldwide. Additionally, refractory septic shock is one of the most significant groups that contributes to a high death rate. The interaction of pyroptosis, apoptosis, and necroptosis results in a unique inflammatory cell death mechanism known as PANoptosis.

pmc-11441154.title: Effect of napabucasin and doxorubicin via the Jak2/Stat3 signaling pathway in suppressing the proliferation of neuroblastoma cells
pmc-11441154.creator: İlker Ünlü, Mehmet Cudi Tuncer, İlhan Özdemir
pmc-11441154.description: Purpose:Napabucasin (NP) is a natural compound that can suppress cancer cell proliferation and cell cycle by inhibition of the signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) gene. We examined the effects of NP on the proliferation and invasion of neuroblastoma cells (SH-SY5Y).Methods:Human neuroblastoma SH-SY5Y cell line was used in this study.

pmc-11622919.title: Comparing tuberculosis symptom screening to chest X-ray with artificial intelligence in an active case finding campaign in Northeast Nigeria
pmc-11622919.creator: Stephen John, Suraj Abdulkarim, Salisu Usman, Md Toufiq Rahman, Jacob Creswell
pmc-11622919.description: BackgroundUltra-portable X-ray devices with artificial intelligence (AI) are increasingly used to screen for tuberculosis (TB). Few studies have documented their performance. We aimed to evaluate the performance of chest X-ray (CXR) and symptom screening for active case finding of TB among remote populations using ultra-portable X-ray and AI.

pmc-11668917.title: Drug-Eluting Beads Bronchial Arterial Chemoembolization Combined with Immunotherapy Resulted in Pathological Complete Response of Squamous Cell Lung Cancer: A Case Report
pmc-11668917.creator: Guanghui He, Kunning Yang, Zhi Gao, Xiaofa Zhang, Aiqiang Han
pmc-11668917.description: The incidence of lung cancer is the highest among all tumors, and treatment has become an urgent problem to be solved. The Drug-eluting bead-based bronchial arterial chemoembolization (DEB-BACE) combination immunotherapy is a rare neoadjuvant therapy for lung cancer surgery, which can significantly reduce the time it takes for lung cancer patients to undergo surgery.

pmc-12650243.title: Shaping Precision Medicine: The Journey of Sequencing Technologies Across Human Solid Tumors
pmc-12650243.creator: Wanwen Li, Chanyu Xiong, Chen Chu, Yun Zhang, Zihao Wang, Zunmin Wan, Peng Tang, Shikai Zhu, Yu Zhou
pmc-12650243.description: Solid tumors collectively drive the global cancer burden, with profound molecular heterogeneity demanding precision and molecularly informed management. Advances in sequencing technologies have established molecular taxonomy as a cornerstone of clinical oncology, progressively superseding traditional histopathological classifications. Sanger sequencing remains the gold standard for validating guideline mandated actionable variants.

pmc-12709844.title: Yield performance and stability of durum wheat varieties in northwestern Ethiopia
pmc-12709844.creator: Ahadu Menzir, Yalemtesfa Firew, Mulatu Kassaye, Gebremeskel Mequanint
pmc-12709844.description: A key challenge for plant breeders is to achieve high durum wheat yield in Ethiopia across various locations while minimizing environmental influences. Fourteen varieties were tested using atriplicate RCBD design.The experiment was conducted over two consecutive main cropping seasons (2020–2021) at three different locations: Felege Birhan, Sebshengo, and Felege Selam Farmers Training Center, consisting a total of six test environments.

pmc-13580365.title: Changes in LDL-C levels among primary health care patients with hypertension, coronary artery disease, and diabetes during a 36-month follow-up
pmc-13580365.creator: Petra Valkonen, Ulla Mikkonen, Hannu Kautiainen, Pekka Mäntyselkä, Nina Tusa
pmc-13580365.description: Background and aimsLow-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) level is one important modifiable risk factor for cardiovascular diseases. This study aimed to describe the characteristics of primary health care patients with hypertension, coronary artery disease, or diabetes according to their LDL-C levels and to observe changes in these levels and medications during the 36-month follow-up.

pmc-13581757.title: IL-5/IL-5R blockade enables safe non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agent reintroduction in non-steroidal anti-inflammatory exacerbated respiratory disease
pmc-13581757.creator: Pelin Korkmaz, Nevzat Kahveci, Semra Demir, Osman Ozan Yegit, Derya Unal, Merve Hormet Igde, Mehmet E. Sezgin, Ayse F. Aslan, Bircan Erden, Leyla Bolek, Merve D. Atasever, Selin E. Guzel, Şule Çelik Kamacı, Esra Kaya, Aslı Gelincik
pmc-13581757.description: BackgroundBiologic therapies targeting the interleukin-5 (IL-5) pathway improve asthma control and chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyposis (CRSwNP) in patients with non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID)-exacerbated respiratory disease (NERD). However, their effect on NSAID tolerance remains insufficiently characterized.ObjectiveThis study aimed to investigate whether anti-IL-5/IL-5 receptor (IL-5R) treatments could improve NSAID tolerance in patients with NERD and Blended Reactions (BRs).
